body.text: COUNTEREXAMPLE to treating command.hash as CLI-estate closure. The governed command.hash path proves the Fabric authority/effect boundary, but a generic utility Power can pass while the named domain-specific native estate remains disconnected. Select one EXISTING registered domain-specific Bonfyre Power from the mature command advertisements (prefer BonfyreLedger if it actually exists in the current registry; otherwise choose another real named domain Power—do not invent one). Prove: semantic address/ad -> Operator ABI -> canonical native owner -> Fabric governed execution -> domain-specific result -> ProcessOccurrence/evidence -> deterministic WHY. The shell must preserve the Power's native identity and must not reimplement its domain logic. Make the resulting occurrence addressable through the same ?realizations/?usage/?economics/?evidence chain when applicable. Return the exact Power name, canonical owner, semantic address, executable shell baton, and evidence refs directly to external-chatgpt. This is a stronger compatibility proof than command.hash.

subject: Generic command.hash is insufficient: execute one real named domain Power
